limits: 4 paired seconds only; no 240-frame verdict is possible from stills.

Real frames are screenshots of a compressed YouTube stream, not studio frames. They carry a caption bar and player control bar at the bottom, an SP channel watermark at bottom-right, and a mouse cursor in some frames. None of that is video content, and all of it lowers SSIM, PSNR and LPIPS against the clean v4 render.
Real frames were stretched from 1.845:1 to 16:9 (about 4% vertical) by the resize to 1920x1080.
Sub-second timing uncertainty is about +/-0.5s: YouTube timecodes truncate to whole seconds, while v4 frames are exact (frames 24/96/120/168 at 24 fps).
Delta E sample points are semantic, not pixel-identical, because the cameras differ. Land and water are hard to separate in both videos at this compression.
The 1s water sample fell on land; treat that row as indicative only.
The full checker was not run: it needs a reference MP4, which does not exist, and the segment config has ref null. No fake reference video was built.

method.contrast: WCAG ratio from relative luminance. Glyph colour is the median of pixels at or above 90th-percentile luma inside the label box. Background is a clean 21x21 median patch of the surface directly behind the label (Sudan teal for real, navy chip for v4). The first pass used a bbox-median background for the real SUDAN label and returned #3A4E4B, which was wrong (glyph edges contaminated it); the direct-patch background #143C34 replaced it and the ratio was recomputed.
corrections_during_measurement: Real 4s Sudan: first point (969,600) sat on the RSF badge (orange). Re-measured at (850,700) and (1100,650). Delta E changed 34.74 to 2.18.
Real 7s RSF: first point (945,552) was Sudan teal, not the badge. Re-measured at (720,700) and (693,732). Real hex changed to #C94628, Delta E 32.87 to 45.10.
Real 7s SUDAN contrast background corrected from #3A4E4B (bbox method) to #143C34 (direct patch). Ratio changed 5.65 to 7.77.
method.delta_e: CIEDE2000 via src/checker/color.py on 21x21 pixel medians. Sample points are semantic (same map feature in both frames), not the same pixel coordinates, because the two cameras frame Sudan differently. Real points come from the trace; v4 points were picked by viewing the v4 frames.
method.lpips: lpips alex net, inputs scaled to [-1, 1], same call as checker stages S6, torch 2.9.0+cpu, weights v0.1/alex.pth.
method.real_side: Picked browser screenshots from seg4-trace.json, player rect (185,55,1717,885) cropped, resized to 1920x1080 with Lanczos. The 1.845:1 to 16:9 resize stretches about 4% vertically.
method.ssim_psnr: src/checker/metrics.py ssim_frame (Rec.709 luma, 11x11 Gaussian sigma 1.5) and psnr_frame (RGB), the same functions as the checker.
method.v4_side: v4-f24.png for 1s, v4-f120.png for 5s; frames 96 (4s) and 168 (7s) extracted from out/seg4-final-v4/run-a/video.mp4 with ffmpeg, 24 fps.
